top_signals.title: Merz Warns Russia Aims to Destabilize European Continent
top_signals.summary: German Chancellor Friedrich Merz said that Russian President Vladimir Putin is seeking to not only defeat Ukraine, but to also undermine democracy in Europe and further integration. “My biggest concern is the underestimated Russian impact on our societies,” Merz said Monday in an exclusive interview with Bloomberg’s Francine Lacqua. “Russia is on the way to destabilize the entire political order of our European continent.” (Source: Bloomberg)
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Army acquisition command awards contracts worth $6.8B in 2026
top_signals.summary: The Mission and Installation Contracting Command awarded 21,450 contracts in fiscal 2026 valued at $6.8 billion in total, a boost from the year prior.

top_signals.title: CoreWeave’s Business Is Sound Despite Debt Fears, JPMorgan Says
top_signals.summary: Investor concerns over CoreWeave Inc.’s mounting debt and rapid cash burn are likely overdone, analysts at JPMorgan Chase & Co. said, given that rapid expansion is driving its financing needs rather than weak project economics.
